brief:
Two Palestinians died from injuries sustained in an Israeli strike on the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis in southern Gaza early Sunday, Al Jazeera reported, citing Nasser Medical Centre. The strike hit the coastal enclave's southern region in the early hours.

Medical sources documented the deaths as resulting from the strike, which targeted the densely populated area near Khan Younis.

title: Two Palestinians die from wounds in Israeli strike on Gaza
